what: A-03 paired sensory-RNG evidence: external Poisson drive events (neuron id, time ms) for ONE trial, replayed for two wiring arms with the per-trial seed protocol. Identical event lists = the sensory train is a pure function of (task id, trial index), independent of the wiring.
seed_recipe: torch.manual_seed = sha256('a03-spike-drive:{task}:{row}')[:4] & 0x7FFFFFFF, set once before the trial's step loop
